_about: Hand-kept additions to RAYDAR's medicines dictionary. The dictionary itself (RAYDAR medicines.json) is built from the
Australian Medicines Terminology (AMT) and the PBS by `npm run dict:update` (run from raydar-app/). Edit this file, then run that again.
This file never makes a medicine prohibited. Only a study's eSource does that; this file only helps RAYDAR recognise names.
Every line says who added it and when ('by', 'date'). Clinical judgements ('review') stay marked until a doctor has checked them.
aliases: other names recruiters hear, pointing at AMT ingredient names, e.g. { "name": "blue puffer", "to": ["salbutamol"], "by": "TST", "date": "2026-12-01" }.
ingredients: medicines AMT doesn't have (often herbal), with any groups they belong to, e.g. { "name": "st john's wort", "groups": ["x-herbal"], "by": "TST", "date": "2026-12-01" }.
groups: RAYDAR's own groups (codes start with x-). The rule-based ones are filled by the build from AMT names; hand groups list their members and the source they came from.
liveVaccines: corrections to the rule 'a vaccine is live when its AMT name says live'.
groupWords: words in a prohibited-list item that suggest a drug group, used only to pre-fill the study admin. TST confirms every item before it counts.

x-vaccine.name: Vaccines
x-vaccine.rule: AMT name contains 'vaccine', or is a COVID-19 mRNA vaccine (ends in -meran), or is BCG

x-vaccine-live.name: Live vaccines
x-vaccine-live.rule: a vaccine whose AMT name says 'live', with the corrections in liveVaccines

x-cannabis.name: Medicinal cannabis (any cannabinoid)
x-cannabis.rule: AMT ingredient is a cannabinoid (THC, CBD, CBG, CBN and others)

x-herbal.name: Herbal medicines
x-herbal.rule: hand-kept: ingredients listed in this file with this group

x-vaccine-mrna.name: mRNA vaccines
x-vaccine-mrna.rule: AMT ingredient name ends in -meran (COVID-19 mRNA vaccines) or says mRNA

notLive.name: mpox live replication deficient vaccine
notLive.why: AMT calls it 'live replication deficient'; it cannot replicate, so it is not usually treated as a live vaccine

live.why: BCG is live bacteria; the AMT name doesn't say 'live'

groupWords.why: "GIP drugs" (e.g. EMBOLD's "Incretins (GLP-1 or GIP drugs)") means tirzepatide (Mounjaro), a GIP and GLP-1 drug the PBS files under A10BX, not with the GLP-1 drugs in A10BJ. Pre-fill only: TST confirms each item in the study admin.
